verdict.rationale: WooCommerce's REST API docs list official client libraries for JavaScript, PHP, Python and Ruby. They wrap a documented, versioned REST API (wc/v3) that supports full CRUD and key-based auth with read/write scoping. Evidence on the SDKs themselves is a single listing line. Missing for 10: SDK-specific documentation and maintenance or versioning status, coverage of more languages such as TypeScript or Go, a published OpenAPI spec (probe found none), and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Official libraries: JavaScript Library, PHP Library, Python Library, Ruby Library
WooCommerce (WC) 2.6+ is fully integrated with the WordPress REST API. This allows WC data to be created, read, updated, and deleted using requests in JSON format
Choose the level of access for this REST API key, which can be Read access, Write access or Read/Write access.
